purpose: This table provides one cleaned row per runway record from the OurAirports runway reference dataset, feeding downstream airport-infrastructure and flight-planning analyses that need runway dimensions, surface, orientation, and lighting/closure status.
usage: Join on airport_ref (or airport_ident) to link runways to airports, and treat le_/he_ prefixed columns as the two ends of each runway; consumers should expect nulls in coordinate, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold columns and handle them explicitly rather than assuming zero or a default.
limitations: Coordinate and elevation fields (le_/he_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading) carry null rates between roughly 0.22 and 0.28, and displaced-threshold fields are missing in 0.88 and 0.90 of rows respectively; none of these were imputed, so aggregates over them must account for substantial missingness, and airport_ref/airport_ident were cast or kept based on sampled formats only, not validated against the airports table.
